desc.en: A tool that reacts to mysterious powers in nature. It's useful for finding effective herbs, rare minerals, and other things that one would not normally notice.
desc.ja: 自然に宿る不思議な力に反応する道具。薬効の強いハーブや変異した鉱石など、普段は気づかないものを見つけるのに役立つ

desc.en: Effect: Increases sell price at shops by a good amount.
desc.ja: 効果：お店の買取価格がけっこう上がる

desc.en: Effect: Reduces necessary Search Equipment frames by 1. Cannot be reduced lower than 1.
desc.ja: 効果：探索装備の装備枠を１つ減らす。最低でも装備枠は１つになる

desc.en: Increases transfer PP by 7 when this item is used as a material in Synthesis.
desc.ja: この潜力のついた材料を使って調合すると、引き継ぎＰＰ枠が７増加する

desc.en: Increases the chances of finding better relics in the field.
desc.ja: フィールドで、より良い遺物を発見できる可能性が高くなる

desc.en: Greatly increases the chances of finding better relics in the field.
desc.ja: フィールドで、より良い遺物を発見できる可能性が非常に高くなる
